key_findings.title: Latest reported results

statements.text: Kaspi.kz revenue increased 15% year-over-year to KZT1.1 trillion ($2.3 billion).
Adjusted EBITDA increased 5% year-over-year to KZT397 billion ($826 million).
Net income was stable at KZT259 billion ($539 million), even with investments in Türkiye and high funding costs in Kazakhstan.

key_findings.question: What explains the reported movement after separating reporting scope, currency and one-off items? The selected evidence does not quantify a causal bridge.
key_findings.boundary: Source statements are not independently verified. Preserve the quoted period, units and named entity/measure; no annualization or scope substitution.

key_findings.title: Annual reported growth and profitability
key_findings.question: Are the annual observations comparable in business scope and accounting basis? These calculations do not establish organic growth or explain a newer quarter.
key_findings.boundary: Annual group net-income margin is not parent-attributable profit or operating margin. Reported growth is not constant-currency growth. See all input warnings.

key_findings.title: Operating drivers

statements.text: e-Commerce continued to be our main growth driver.
Constant-currency e-Commerce GMV increased 28% year-over-year to KZT1.3 trillion ($2.6 billion), while purchases increased 33% year-over-year.
We’re also seeing good results growing revenue from value-added services, namely advertising and delivery.
During 2Q 2026, constant currency VAS revenue increased 49% year-over-year.
As a result, e-Commerce 3P take rate increased 160 bps year-over-year to 16.1%, and e-Commerce revenue grew significantly faster than GMV.
During 2Q 2026, e-Commerce revenue increased 35% year-over-year on a constant currency basis to KZT394 billion ($820 million).

key_findings.question: How do the named operating measures translate into comparable revenue and profit? Keep segment measures, volumes and reported/constant-currency growth separate.
key_findings.boundary: Source statements are not independently verified. Preserve the quoted period, units and named entity/measure; no annualization or scope substitution.

key_findings.title: Credit-risk evidence

statements.text: As at 31 December 2025 and 30 June 2026, the Group’s restructured loans in Stage 3 amounted to the gross carrying amount of KZT 145,302 million and KZT 178,567 million, respectively.

key_findings.question: What are the exposure denominator, coverage and movements behind this disclosed risk measure? A loan subset is not total NPLs or a loss rate; balance-sheet dates are not quarterly flows.
key_findings.boundary: Source statements are not independently verified. Preserve the quoted period, units and named entity/measure; no annualization or scope substitution.

key_findings.title: Management's explanation

statements.text: Fintech revenue increased 23% year-over-year to KZT455 billion ($946 million), supported by 18% growth in average net loan portfolio.
Adjusted EBITDA increased 6% year-over-year to KZT171 billion ($356 million), with growth continuing to reflect higher funding costs.

key_findings.question: Does other evidence corroborate this management explanation, and how much of the movement does it explain? No causal contribution is calculated here.
key_findings.boundary: Source statements are not independently verified. Preserve the quoted period, units and named entity/measure; no annualization or scope substitution.
